content.identity: RUN_ID is independent; CP_AT groups work. source_commit is source repository Git, never BE Git.
content.storage: Latest-only node observations (two kinds). Every finish retains the latest 100 run summaries plus RUNNING/referenced runs, deleting at most 200 obsolete summaries per call; prune permits earlier cleanup. No result snapshots or finding observation history.
content.scope: Explicit scope nodes required; failures update last attempt only; increments exclude unrelated nodes.
content.freshness: Hash comparison is only input freshness; analyzer/rules/config currency needs separate caller comparison.
content.coverage: CHECKED needs rule_ids and all_applicable_checks_completed=true with no unresolved boundaries. Zero findings never means safe. Linked complete scans require an explicitly CHECKED PROJECT root or matching scoped MODEL root. Incremental absence reconciliation requires exact source_files; individual nodes never authorize broader resolution.
content.limits: 200 nodes per run, 32KiB scope, 4KiB summaries. Put detailed reports externally.
content.git: Excluded from BE Git CSV staging, commit, merge and restore. Restore preserves local analysis rows and includes them in websocket replacement data. Full database export includes them.
content.ai_workflow: AI must start a separate AI/HYBRID run with explicit existing targets, source basis and limits. Finish after architecture writes, report unsupported paths as PARTIAL, never infer CHECKED from zero findings. Link security scan via analysis_run_id for atomic finding/coverage saves. Use report_ref for detail.
content.parser: Parser facts hash is scope evidence, not a source snapshot hash. Dirty/source snapshot freshness stays unknown unless actual source provenance is supplied. Security parser runs cover supported catalog rules at project scope; object coverage is not inferred from findings.
content.synchronization: Server retains exact analysis-bearing transactions in the existing TB_C_TRANSACTION synchronization journal across reconnects, independently of bounded run summaries. Exact retries skip all units, including pruned runs; reused IDs with changed contents and new optimistic-lock conflicts fail. Journal payloads are excluded from Git CSV but contribute to full database size.
content.checkpoint_relationship: CP_AT groups architecture changes and may link multiple independent RUN_IDs. Analysis states are latest observations, not checkpoint snapshots. beyond_get_architecture_diff reports architecture node changes only; it cannot reconstruct historical analysis states or security coverage.
content.retry: Retry the same run_id with identical inputs. Reused IDs with changed payloads and stale revisions fail; re-read current state and start a new run instead of overwriting newer observations.

examples.note: Replace project_id and source provenance with values verified from the active project and source repository.
